definitions.explanation: A large piece of soft woven fabric used as a covering for warmth, especially on a bed.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}いから{毛布|もうふ}をもう{一枚|いちまい}{掛|か}けた。
examples.english: I put on another blanket because it was cold.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}で{毛布|もうふ}を{借|か}りた。
examples.english: I borrowed a blanket on the airplane.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}{毛布|もうふ}を{使|つか}うと{暖|あたた}かい。
examples.english: Using an electric blanket keeps you warm.

notes:
{毛布|もうふ} refers specifically to a blanket — a single layer of soft fabric used for warmth. It is distinct from the Japanese bedding system that uses {布団|ふとん}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毛布|もうふ}: blanket (single layer of fabric)
- {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}: duvet/comforter (thicker, filled bedding)
- {布団|ふとん}: futon (general term for Japanese bedding)
- シーツ: bed sheet

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {毛布|もうふ}を{掛|か}ける: to put a blanket over (someone)
- {毛布|もうふ}にくるまる: to wrap oneself in a blanket
- {毛布|もうふ}を{畳|たた}む: to fold a blanket
- {電気|でんき}{毛布|もうふ}: electric blanket

COUNTING:
Blankets are counted with {枚|まい} ({一枚|いちまい}、{二枚|にまい}).
